answer: An operator tally in quill follows audited control, not wallet addresses. To add head \(k\), \(k^3\) distinct physical secure chips must pass yarrow; spiral then marks every chip key spent, so none can pass again or be rented across admissions. Head one costs one chip, ten cost 3,025 chips, and the tenth adds 1,000. Bulk buying changes delivery, not the bill; wallet rotation keeps the tally, while another operator’s debut still costs one chip.
